turns.text: /navigator Use user style tony. How does a short link get resolved when someone visits it?

A visit to `/docs` goes through these steps:

- `src/server.js:11` takes the path after the slash and decodes it, so `/docs` becomes `docs`.
- `src/resolve.js:2` lowercases the code and looks it up in the store (`src/store.js:4-6`). Unknown code: 404 (`src/resolve.js:3`).
- If the link has an `expiresAt` that has passed, it answers 410 Gone (`src/resolve.js:4`).
- Otherwise it counts the hit (`src/store.js:7-10`) and answers 302 with `Location` set to the target URL (`src/resolve.js:5-6`, `src/server.js:13`).

Note: hit counts live only in memory (`src/store.js:2`), so they reset when the server restarts.

Summary: path, then lowercase lookup, then 404, 410, or a 302 redirect.
